question: What happens to a greedy initiate who prioritizes outer ritual?
premises: One who spreads outer display makes consciousness secondary.
Such a person does not obtain the descent of power.
The Svacchanda Tantra states that even such an initiate does not share in liberation.
inference: Outer-prioritizing greed blocks the descent of power, so even initiation does not yield liberation.
plain_english: By promoting outer display and making consciousness secondary, such a person does not receive the descent of power. It is said in the Svacchanda Tantra that even one initiated in that state does not attain liberation.
